cues.en: Now that is it for transitions and tween stores or spring stores and for this animate functionality
where passive items are animated as well.
These are all extremely useful features to provide a better user experience.
Also, check out the official docs at this point where you can find the full documentation of all possible
configurations and also a nice advanced transition technique where you have the word transitions.
With that, you should have a nice toolbox that allows you to not just provide great user experiences
regarding your component structure and your data, but also regarding how the data changes and how these
changes are reflected on the screen.
